Aqua Kids.name: Aqua Kids
Aqua Kids.summary: Aqua Kids is an action game based on the Japanese animated CG TV show broadcast on TV Tokyo. Two modes of play are available. A battle mode has you collect items and defeat enemies. A "Help Daibo" mode has you find items in order to power up your "Daibo" robot.

FIFA 2001 - World Championship.name: FIFA 2001: Major League Soccer
FIFA 2001 - World Championship.summary: FIFA 2001 aims to immerse its fans with the most realistic football experience possible. Over 50 international teams, including England, France, Germany, Holland, Spain, and the United States have made the cut, while 17 of the planet's top leagues have been incorporated as well. New motion captured moves from Matthaus, Mendieta, Scholes, and other soccer legends support the game's realism, with animated linesman and authentic light sourcing add that much more to the presentation. Perhaps the most important features, though, are the advanced sets of artificial intelligence, in-game cinematic cutscenes, and a ton of game modes that have been specially built for tournaments from around the world.

Fragrance Tale.name: Fragrance Tale
Fragrance Tale.summary: A visual novel for PlayStation 2, PC and SEGA Dreamcast.

Legend of Spyro, The - A New Beginning.name: The Legend of Spyro: A New Beginning
Legend of Spyro, The - A New Beginning.summary: The Legend of Spyro: A New Beginning explores the true origins of Spyro as you embark on a dangerous, combat-driven quest that will bring you face to face with the Dark Master's ultimate creation, Cynder. Experience the true power of the purple dragon as you unleash devastating fury attacks, upgradeable breaths and ground to aerial melee combos in a frenzied battle with hordes of menacing enemies and bone-chilling bosses. It's an epic and cinematic gameplay experience.

LMA Manager 2006.name: LMA Manager 2006
LMA Manager 2006.summary:
All new transfer system, all new look, same brilliant gameplay!

LMA Manager 2006 represents a massive leap forward in the series - now with an even more realistic transfer market - and as challenging and playable as ever!

Realistic Transfer System
Giving you more complex negotiations and more control than ever before.

Stunning 3D Match
See your manager take charge from the touch-line!

Brand New Look
Incredible new visuals and more realistic look.

Share Content & Update Your Stats Online

Commentary from Alan Hansen & Gary Lineker.

NCAA Football 2005.name: NCAA Football 2005
NCAA Football 2005.summary: NCAA Football 2005 is an American college football video game which was released on July 15, 2004. It is the successor to NCAA Football 2004 in the NCAA Football series. The product features former Pittsburgh Panthers and current Arizona Cardinals standout wide receiver Larry Fitzgerald on the cover. The game is the NCAA Football series released by EA Sports. This would be the final game in the NCAA Football series to be released on the Nintendo Gamecube.

Rock Band - Country Track Pack.name: Rock Band: Country Track Pack
Rock Band - Country Track Pack.summary: Rock Band Country Track Pack is a standalone game that wraps up 21 country songs into one retail package. The songs are a collection of previously released DLC, as well as new tracks that have yet to appear in any Rock Band game.

Rock'N'Roll Adventures.name: Rock 'n' Roll Adventures
Rock'N'Roll Adventures.summary: Bash and trash crazed instruments with Elviz's legendery guiter, or strum those strings for a bolt of Sonic Power to blast away Dastardly Drums, Clashing Cymbals and more! Run, Push, Swipe and Jump your way through three massive levels with moving objects, intelligent enemies and hidden rooms! Its time to ROCK N ROLL!

SingStar Singalong with Disney.name: SingStar: Singalong with Disney
SingStar Singalong with Disney.summary:
SingStar Singalong with Disney is a karaoke game featuring the most famous hits from Disney movies, from Tarzan to Sleeping Beauty without forgetting Aladdin or Peter Pan.

The game gives points which are distributed by the purity of singing, as in how well does one manage to stay on tune. It doesn't matter if you change octaves in the middle of the song or what words are you singing in (it doesn't have a word recognition), so your singing is rated by how well you manage to hit the correct note at the correct time

Sonic Unleashed.name: Sonic Unleashed
Sonic Unleashed.summary:
Sonic the Hedgehog struggles to undo the damage done to the world and himself after Dr. Eggman unleashes an ancient evil which causes him to transform into a vicious Werehog by night.

The version of Sonic Unleashed developed by Dimps for the Wii and PlayStation 2 differs somewhat in design and and mechanics from the one made by Sonic Team for other platforms, including a different engine and fewer high-speed daytime levels.

Sphinx and the Cursed Mummy.name: Sphinx and the Cursed Mummy
Sphinx and the Cursed Mummy.summary: Sphinx and The Cursed Mummy is an original 3rd person action-adventure inspired by the mythology of ancient Egypt. Travelling the world via magical portals to foil the evil plans of Set. Sphinx's Journey will require all his wits, agility, and special powers. He will also rely on his reluctant hero friend, The Mummy, to help when being inconspicuous is the only solution. By finding the stolen magical crowns of Egypt, Sphinx can stop Set and save the world.
